units.source_text: 源氏内大臣虽为小女公子作此打算，但也深恐明石姬心情不快，所以并不强请。

en.t: Although Genji, the Inner Minister, had made these plans for the young lady, he was also deeply afraid that Lady Akashi would be displeased, and so he did not press the matter.

units.source_text: 他写信去问：“穿裙仪式之事，应如何举行？”

en.t: He wrote to ask her, "How should the skirt-wearing ceremony be carried out?"

units.source_text: 明石姬复道：“想来想去，教她住在我这一无可取的人身边，对她的前程终是不利的。

en.t: Lady Akashi replied, "After thinking it over again and again, I feel that letting her live beside someone as worthless as me would in the end be bad for her future.

units.source_text: 然而教她参与贵人之列，又恐被人耻笑。……”

en.t: Yet if she is placed among people of high rank, I fear she may be laughed at by others..."

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣看了这回信，很可怜她，但也无可奈何。

en.t: When Genji, the Inner Minister, read this reply, he felt great pity for her, but there was nothing he could do.
